record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.original_question: Let D be a regular ultrafilter on I, and let C(D) be the set of all pairs of infinite regular cardinals (κ1,κ2) whose corresponding unfilled cuts occur in (ω,<)^I/D. If (κ1,κ2) belongs to C(D), must the symmetric cut (κ1 + κ2, κ1 + κ2) also belong to C(D)?

evidence.quote: Problem 1.11. Suppose (κ1, κ2) ∈ C(D). Is (κ1 + κ2, κ1 + κ2) ∈ C(D)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $I$ be an infinite set and let $D$ be a regular ultrafilter on $I$ (i.e., there is a family $\{X_i : i \in I\} \subseteq D$ such that every infinite subfamily has empty intersection). Consider the ultrapower $(\omega, <)^I/D$ of the natural linear order. For regular infinite cardinals $\kappa_1, \kappa_2$, a $(\kappa_1, \kappa_2)$-pre-cut in $(\omega, <)^I/D$ is a pair of sequences $\langle a_\alpha : \alpha < \kappa_1\rangle$, $\langle b_\beta : \beta < \kappa_2\rangle$ with $a_\alpha < a_{\alpha'} < b_{\beta'} < b_\beta$ for $\alpha < \alpha' < \kappa_1$, $\beta' < \beta < \kappa_2$; such a pre-cut is unfilled (a cut) if there is no element $c$ of the ultrapower with $a_\alpha < c < b_\beta$ for all $\alpha < \kappa_1, \beta < \kappa_2$. Define
$$C(D) = \{(\kappa_1, \kappa_2) : \kappa_1, \kappa_2 \text{ regular infinite, and } (\omega,<)^I/D \text{ has an unfilled } (\kappa_1,\kappa_2)\text{-cut}\}.$$
Question: If $(\kappa_1, \kappa_2) \in C(D)$, must $(\kappa_1 + \kappa_2,\, \kappa_1 + \kappa_2) \in C(D)$?
artifact.category_tag: Regular ultrafilters and cuts in ultrapowers
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the existence of a $(\kappa_1,\kappa_2)$-cut in a regular ultrapower forces the symmetric cut $(\kappa_1+\kappa_2,\kappa_1+\kappa_2)$ to occur appears as an open problem in the literature on cofinality spectrum problems and regular ultrafilters by Malliaris and Shelah. Partial results exist (e.g., ruling out symmetric $(\kappa,\kappa)$-cuts under treetops hypotheses, and constructions producing many alternations of cuts using large cardinals), but no full resolution of this implication appears in recent searches.

status_evidence.title: Cofinality spectrum theorems in model theory, set theory and general topology
status_evidence.snippet: If D is a regular ultrafilter on λ with λ+-treetops and κ < λ+ regular, then (κ,κ) ∉ C(D).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results restrict when symmetric cuts can appear, but no general implication is established.

status_evidence.title: Model-theoretic applications of cofinality spectrum problems
status_evidence.snippet: Investigation of realization and omission of symmetric cuts; constructions producing alternations of cuts using measurable cardinals.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between asymmetric and symmetric cuts in C(D) remains an active research topic.
